description: Update only the supplied name, description, or instructions of an existing project by ID; omitted fields are preserved. Requires write access and returns the updated project metadata and permissions. Use move_project to change its workspace or invite_share to grant access.

description.description: Project description; omit on updates to retain its current value.

id.description: Project ID returned by list_projects, get_project, or create_project.

instructions.description: Project instructions for document generation; omit on updates to preserve them.

name.description: Project display name. Required for creation; optional on update.

name: update_project
title: Update Project
